# Skeleton

Skeleton: a placeholder shaped like the content that is loading, so the layout does not jump when it arrives.

Also asked as: loading placeholder, shimmer, ghost.

**Import:** `import { Skeleton } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/loading/Skeleton/Skeleton.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/loading/Skeleton/Skeleton.stories.jsx` — LabelPresets, PresetWinsOverShape, TagGroupPreset, Shapes, Rect, Circle, Text, PresetNamesAShape, Paragraph, Shimmer, ReducedMotion, LoadingTable, LoadingCard, IgnoredPropsWarn, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/loading/Skeleton/Skeleton.mdx`

**Motion:** change `linear`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations › Expression › Motion.

## Usage

Use `Skeleton` while content loads, so the space it will fill is already on
screen and the layout does not jump when it arrives.

- **One label loading on its own** (a status calculated after the row appears, a
  tag list fetched separately): the matching preset.
- **A thumbnail, avatar or header:** a rectangle or circle with its own size.

## Motion

Skeleton reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Load content | `--ds-motion-linear` | Shimmer from top-left to bottom-right; content fades in over it. |

## Best practices

### Shape the placeholder like its content. {#shape-the-placeholder-like-its-content}

A paragraph placeholder promises lines of text; a block promises an image.

Do: Paragraph preset for a paragraph.
Don't: A rectangle standing in for text.

### Pair a circle with text for people. {#pair-a-circle-with-text-for-people}

An avatar placeholder is round; a square one misleads about what will load.

Do: Circle beside a text line.
Don't: Rectangle beside a text line.

### Keep the shimmer on while loading. {#keep-the-shimmer-on-while-loading}

The shimmer tells the person the content is still coming; a frozen skeleton
reads as a broken page. Leave `isShimmering` at its default.

### Use a label preset when one label loads after its row is on screen. {#use-a-label-preset-when-one-label-loads-after-its-row-is-on-screen}

A preset has the label's height and corners, so nothing moves when the value arrives.

Do: The status preset, the size of the Status tag it stands in for.
Don't: A free rectangle at its default size, so the row jumps when the status arrives.

### Use plain text bars inside a loading table or card. {#use-plain-text-bars-inside-a-loading-table-or-card}

The container owns the skeleton. Labels become the same text bars as the rest,
so a loading table does not fill with dozens of label shapes.

Do: Text bars throughout the row.
Don't: Label shapes inside a loading container.

### Skip the skeleton on a count in a button, tab or nav item. {#skip-the-skeleton-on-a-count-in-a-button-tab-or-nav-item}

Show nothing until the number arrives; `CountTag` already renders nothing without a value.

### Skeleton the host, not a count inside it. {#skeleton-the-host-not-a-count-inside-it}

For a `CountTag` inside a `StatusTag` or `Tag`, use one `preset="status"` for the whole label.

### Leave flags, modals, menus and spinners out. {#leave-flags-modals-menus-and-spinners-out}

They appear when they have something to say. A Tag saving a change keeps its
own spinner (`isLoading`), so saving and loading look different.

## Accessibility

- **Every skeleton is hidden from assistive tech.** It renders `aria-hidden="true"`
  with no role, never takes focus and ignores the pointer, so a screen reader
  does not read a list of empty items and a placeholder cannot be clicked.
- **The loading region carries the busy state.** Set `aria-busy="true"` once on
  the container that is loading, and remove it when the content arrives. The
  component does not set it, because it cannot see the region.
- **Pair the busy state with a live label.** `aria-busy` alone is not announced
  by every screen reader. Render a visually hidden `role="status"` element
  **beside** the busy region, not inside it: content inside a busy region may
  be held back until it is no longer busy. Mount the status **empty** and set
  its text after mount ("Loading students…"), because text a status already
  holds when it mounts is not announced. Keep it mounted, and when the content
  arrives, set its text again ("Students loaded").

```jsx
const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
useEffect(() => {
  setMessage(loading ? 'Loading students…' : 'Students loaded');
}, [loading]);

<div role="status" className="visually-hidden">{message}</div>
<section aria-labelledby="students" aria-busy={loading || undefined}>
  <h3 id="students">Students</h3>
  {loading ? <Skeleton shape="text" lines={3} /> : renderStudents(students)}
</section>
```
- **Reduced motion.** Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the shimmer stops
  and the fill is flat.
- **Contrast in any theme.** The fill is `--ds-skeleton` and the shimmer
  `--ds-skeleton-subtle`, both theme tokens.

## Related

- `StatusTag`, `CountTag` and `Tag` are the labels the presets are sized to.
- `Spinner` is for an action in progress and for full-page transitions; a Tag saving a change uses its own spinner.
- The loading guidance in the surfaces guideline points here.

Same group: `GenerativeBorder` · `ProgressBar` · `Spinner`

## Parts

1. **Bar.** A flat fill in the skeleton color: a rectangle, a circle, a text line or a label shape.
2. **Shimmer.** A band that sweeps across. Off, it is a flat fill.
3. **Group.** Lines and tag groups are columns or rows of bars.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | The fill shimmers. |
| Not shimmering | `isShimmering=` is a flat fill, which is also what reduced motion gets. |
| Hovered | None. It ignores the pointer. |
| Pressed | None. |
| Focused | None. It never takes focus. |
| Disabled | None. A placeholder has no disabled state. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Fill | `--ds-skeleton`. |
| Shimmer | A band of `--ds-skeleton-subtle`, 1.6s. |
| Radius | `--radius-md` by default; `--radius-full` for a circle and the person tag; `--radius-sm` for count; or the token named by `radius`. |
| Label presets | Heights from the label height roles, so a placeholder is the size of its label. Count is `--control-sm` wide; status-spacious takes `--radius-0375` (6) for its corner. |
| Sizes | Spacing primitives: `--space-400` (64) for the default height, `--space-200` (32) for the circle, `--space-100` (16) for the text bar. |
| Gap | `--stack-md` between lines and tags. |
| Forced colors | A `--stroke-1` outline keeps the shape. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Draw only the layout the page will have. | Draw a placeholder for a layout the page does not have. |
| Keep the surrounding words, such as column headers, on screen. | Skeleton a heading the person already knows. |
| Name the loading region once, in the live region around it. | Give each placeholder its own label. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `shape` | enum | — | `rect` by default; `circle` for avatars and round counts; `text` is a 16-tall bar that can repeat as `lines`. The same three are also `preset` values, as Figma names them. A preset wins over it, with a warning when they disagree. |
| `preset` | oneOf | — | Every value of Figma's `preset`. `rect`, `circle` and `text` name a shape and resize freely, exactly as `shape` does. The rest are sized to a label (`status`, `status-spacious`, `count`, `tag`, `tag-person`), a loading TagGroup (`tag-group`) or three lines of text (`paragraph`), set shape, height and corners together, and win over them. |
| `width` | number or string | — | Any CSS length, or a number of pixels. Text bars fill the line by default; a label preset has a stand-in width. Ignored by `count` and `tag-group`. A circle takes one size: `width`, or `height` when no width is given. |
| `height` | number or string | — | Any CSS length, or a number of pixels. Ignored, with a warning, by presets and by several text `lines`, which are always 16 tall. |
| `radius` | oneOf | — | A radius token name, such as `element-radius-md` or `card-radius-sm`. Ignored, with a warning, by presets, by `circle` (always round) and by several text `lines`, which keep the text bar's radius. |
| `lines` | number | — | `text` (and `paragraph`) only: how many bars. The last of several is shorter. Ignored, with a warning, on any other shape or preset. |
| `isShimmering` | bool | `true` | The shimmer sweep. Off, it is a flat fill, which is also what reduced motion gets. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `style` | object | — | — |
